gancho: Se subió a un taxi y el chofer sabía su nombre

escenas: Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Elena gets into the back seat in a hurry, holding her phone. Elena says: "A la colonia Roma, por favor. Rápido."

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Martín keeps glancing at her in the rearview mirror. Martín says: "Disculpe… ¿usted es Elena? ¿Elena Torres?"

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Elena lowers her phone, suspicious. Elena says: "¿Nos conocemos?"

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). At a red light Martín takes off his cap and turns around. Martín says: "Soy Martín. Del barrio de Coyoacán."

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Elena's face changes as she recognizes him. Elena says: "Martín… el que me dejó plantada en el altar."

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Martín shakes his head sadly. Martín says: "Yo nunca te dejé. Tu papá no me dejó entrar a la iglesia."

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). Elena's eyes fill with tears. Elena says: "Mi papá me dijo que te habías ido con otra."

Inside a taxi at night, city lights passing outside, later parked under a streetlight. Characters: ELENA (40, elegant, dark business suit, hair in a low bun), MARTÍN (50s, grey mustache, flat cap, taxi driver). The taxi is parked under a streetlight. They look at each other in silence. Martín smiles softly. Martín says: "Veinte años, Elena… ¿todavía te gusta el café de la esquina?"
